top_signals.title: Activist Anson Funds Pushes Lionsgate for Sale, Semafor Says
top_signals.summary: Activist investor Anson Funds Management is urging Lionsgate Studio Corp. to put itself up for sale, Semafor reported, adding to pressure on the independent film and TV production company to do a deal.

top_signals.title: Hong Kong set to include trading firms in ‘big bang’ tax reforms
top_signals.summary: Proposal is part of push by the Chinese territory to compete with Singapore for top-tier financial talent

top_signals.title: Pentagon gives industry 21 days to submit plans for ‘significantly faster’ weapons production
top_signals.summary: In a recent memo, the Pentagon pushed defense companies to accelerate production and delivery of critical weapons.

top_signals.title: Inside Formula 1’s £10,000 hospitality ticket on the back of a moving lorry
top_signals.summary: Formula 1 is expanding the roll-out of a £10,000-per-head hospitality experience which allows VIPs to dine on the track aboard a “travelling dining room”.
